name: gpress
description: Lossless PDF compression in the browser and Node: smaller PDFs that any reader opens, and the gpress archive that restores byte for byte.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p gpress-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p dist && cp ../../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/gpress_wasm.wasm dist/gpress.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js
